sources.observation: The project documents a bounded SAT/SAB/ASM profile and conversion of supported analytic and experimental geometry to CadQuery/OpenCascade shapes; unsupported conversion is explicit.
sources.limits: Shared OCCT kernel family with FreeCAD; format references overlap with ezdxf and CADMPEG; no DWG DataStorage association reader. No semantic run was performed.

sources.observation: The vendor documents SAT/SAB translation to/from OCCT shapes and identifies the component as a commercial extension separate from open-source OCCT core.
sources.limits: No license or component availability is assumed. It is not an open-source peer, does not validate DWG/AcDs ownership, and its OCCT kernel is not independent of FreeCAD/cq-acis geometry construction.

sources.observation: FreeCAD documents its stock DXF importer as unable to read ACIS solids. InventorLoader has its own SAT/SAB parser but uses ezdxf to extract DXF carriers and FreeCAD Part/STEP for geometry construction, with documented unsupported geometry.
sources.limits: Mutable source, unexecuted in this pass; add-on output is not the stock FreeCAD importer, a DWG parser, or an independent OCCT kernel result.

sources.limits: The issue is version- and input-scoped; it is not a universal statement about current master. No peer run or attached drawing review was done.
